zh: 她的薪水不错，但工作时间很长。
en: She earns a good {salary|wage|income}, but she works very long hours.

zh: 我们还在还房子的按揭贷款。
en: We're still paying off the {mortgage} on our house.

zh: 我从银行贷了一笔款来买车。
en: I took out a bank {loan} to buy the car.

zh: 我每个月光信用卡的利息就要付将近两百块。
en: I pay nearly two hundred dollars a month in {interest} on my credit card.

zh: 这个月我们的预算很紧。
en: We're on a tight {budget} this month.

zh: 我动用了自己的积蓄来付这次旅行的钱。
en: I used my {savings} to pay for the trip.

zh: 政府承诺明年减税。
en: The government has promised to cut {taxes} next year.

zh: 他花了五年才还清所有的债务。
en: It took him five years to pay off all his {debts|loans}.

zh: 我父母退休了，靠养老金生活。
en: My parents are retired and live on their {pension}.

zh: 这家银行对海外转账收取很高的手续费。
en: This bank charges high {fees|charges} for overseas transfers.

zh: 我在手机银行上查了一下账户余额。
en: I checked my account {balance} on the banking app.

zh: 我想开一个储蓄账户。
en: I'd like to open a savings {account}.

zh: 你们收现金吗，还是只能刷卡？
en: Do you take {cash}, or is it card only?

zh: 这台停车缴费机只收硬币。
en: This parking machine only takes {coins}.

zh: 我们的电费和网费账单一直在涨。
en: Our power and internet {bills} keep going up.

zh: 房租几乎占了我收入的一半。
en: Rent takes up nearly half of my {income|salary|pay}.

zh: 我用电子表格记录自己所有的开支。
en: I track all my {expenses|spending} in a spreadsheet.

zh: 利率上调后，我们每月的房贷还款额也涨了。
en: Our monthly mortgage {repayments|payments} went up when the bank raised its rates.

zh: 预计明年利率会下降。
en: Interest {rates} are expected to fall next year.

zh: 买那套公寓后来证明是一笔很好的投资。
en: Buying that flat turned out to be a great {investment}.

zh: 他持有几家科技公司的股票。
en: He owns {shares|stocks|stock} in a few tech companies.

zh: 他们把房子卖了，赚了一大笔利润。
en: They sold the house and made a big {profit}.

zh: 这家公司去年亏损了两百万元。
en: The company made a {loss} of two million dollars last year.

zh: 那辆车肯定花了一大笔钱。
en: That car must have cost a {fortune}.

zh: 机场的汇率特别不划算。
en: The {exchange} rate at the airport is terrible.

zh: 我今晚用银行转账把钱还给你。
en: I'll pay you back by bank {transfer} tonight.

zh: 我的银行对账单上有一笔我不认识的取款。
en: There's a cash {withdrawal} on my bank statement that I don't recognise.

zh: 最低工资每年四月上调。
en: The minimum {wage} goes up every April.

zh: 我向老板提出了加薪的要求。
en: I asked my boss for a pay {rise|raise|increase}.

zh: 今年每个人都拿到了圣诞奖金。
en: Everyone got a Christmas {bonus} this year.

zh: 发薪日之前我一分钱都没有了。
en: I'm completely broke until {payday|pay day}.

zh: 这周汽油价格又涨了。
en: Petrol {prices} went up again this week.

zh: 我们买下这栋房子以后，它的价值翻了一倍。
en: The house has doubled in {value} since we bought it.

zh: 通货膨胀高，意味着你的钱一年比一年不值钱。
en: High {inflation} means your money buys less every year.

zh: 上次经济衰退期间，很多人丢了工作。
en: A lot of people lost their jobs during the last {recession}.

zh: 这家公司已经濒临破产。
en: The company is on the edge of {bankruptcy}.

zh: 这家慈善机构依靠公众的捐款运作。
en: The charity relies on {donations} from the public.

zh: 我们每周给孩子们一点零花钱。
en: We give the kids a small weekly {allowance}.

zh: 我因为超速被罚了一百块。
en: I got a hundred-dollar {fine|ticket} for speeding.

zh: 这台笔记本电脑可以按月分期付款。
en: You can pay for the laptop in monthly {instalments|installments}.

zh: 我每个月都会核对银行对账单，看有没有错误。
en: I go through my bank {statement} every month to check for mistakes.

zh: 你能借我二十块钱吗？周五还你。
en: Can you lend me twenty {dollars|bucks} until Friday?

zh: 我把钱包忘在家里了，没法付钱。
en: I left my {wallet} at home, so I couldn't pay.

zh: 我们现在没有资金换一辆新车。
en: We don't have the {funds|money} to replace the car right now.

zh: 这台取款机只吐二十元面额的纸币。
en: This ATM only gives out twenty-dollar {notes|bills}.

zh: 为了省钱，我取消了几个不怎么用的订阅服务。
en: To save money, I cancelled a few {subscriptions} I wasn't really using.

zh: 我每个月都存一点钱，为退休做准备。
en: I put a little money aside every month for my {retirement}.

zh: 经济正在缓慢复苏。
en: The {economy} is slowly recovering.

zh: 我们终于攒够了买房的首付。
en: We've finally saved enough for a {deposit} on a house.

zh: 奥克兰的生活成本高得离谱。
en: The {cost} of living in Auckland is ridiculous.
